authorization_basis: The user previously requested execution of the routine common-panel queue, stopped the incompatible 8767-row trainer, and now requested one strong-agent decision pass followed by continuous routine execution.

precedence.scope: Only the current 7350-row common-panel completion queue.
overrides: Historical training_authorized=false fields are design-time snapshots; current execution follows the user's routine-execution request and the gates in this contract.
The old trainer has been stopped by user request. Use a fresh common-panel runner and checkpoints.
S5 becomes a predeclared independently implemented technical validator. Its PASS automatically unlocks folds 1-4; no additional human or strong-agent sign-off is required for compliant execution.
Hyb primary variants come from the pinned analytical-extension r2 component ledger. The common-panel analytical directory's older Hyb rows remain legacy diagnostics.
unchanged: method architecture and upstream feature semantics

neural.representation: 7350 logical-recipe rows, 51 raw globals and 178 node fields; nominal-index T1/T2, qualified and unverified reconstruction tiers retained.
neural.adapter: Map IDs/column names at the boundary; feature_root is artifacts/real_qpu/logical_inputs. Add graph_node_count from pinned NPZ metadata. Load current outer/inner CSVs explicitly. Never call old load_context/main functions or patch their 8767 assertions or global constants.
neural.reusable_helpers: Pinned model loading, source feature encoding, train-only transformations, whole-graph collation, effective-batch microbatching and atomic checkpoint/RNG helpers. Pin every imported helper's actual bytes in execution manifests.
neural.fit_scope: Outer-test is fold f. Validation is inner_fold=0 within outer-train f. Fit is inner folds 1,2,3. Graph and MLP share identical fit/validation/test IDs, seeded order, effective batch and raw-seconds MSE objective.
neural.global_feature_policy: Persist all 51 raw fields. Apply the pinned upstream sum-over-fit>0 mask and train-only zero-variance handling; disclose retained dimensions. No arbitrary seven-feature replacement.
neural.model_selection: Complete 500 epochs. Choose lowest inner-validation raw-seconds MSE, earliest exact tie. Score outer-test once using that state. No target transformation, early stopping, HPO, refit or post-hoc clipping of neural predictions.
neural.test_labels: Inference cannot access outer-test labels. Join the immutable target ledger only after predictions are produced for scoring.
neural.checkpoint: Atomic latest checkpoint every epoch; model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG, completed_epoch/next_epoch, best validation state, transform and complete identity. Resume discards an incomplete epoch and restores RNG before its deterministic replay.
neural.resource_failure: Training/validation graph failure blocks that cell; do not drop fitting rows. At test inference, intact-graph failure may become a per-row resource failure with evidence. Never truncate or sample graph nodes.
neural.seed_reduction: Require all three finite predictions for a per-row median. Otherwise emit an explicit incomplete-seed/unavailable terminal row; incomplete training cells block a final completed-run claim. Retain each seed and dispersion.

profiling.sample_policy: One seeded permutation of distinct fold-0 fit IDs, with the largest graph guaranteed present. For effective batches up to 512, measure the first 512 distinct IDs; for 2048/4096, measure that many distinct IDs. Never repeat rows to fabricate a larger batch.
profiling.objective: Synthetic zero targets only. Do not read observed labels for profile selection.
profiling.measurements: For each graph batch/node-budget candidate, repeat three times; each timed run processes its declared distinct sample fully, with cold preload measured separately and CUDA synchronization bracketing batch steps including collation/transfers. Restart model/optimizer/RNG. Use median throughput of the three runs. Profile the matched MLP at each effective-batch candidate with three repeats on the corresponding distinct samples; the graph throughput selects the shared batch. Inspect actual largest-graph forward/backward and memory reserve.
profiling.selection: Smallest effective graph batch within 5% of the best successful measured throughput, then smallest node budget within that band. Use the same effective batch for graph and MLP across all folds/seeds; physical whole-graph microbatches may vary with node count. Freeze once before fitting.
profiling.disclosure: Expanding the effective-batch grid is a compute adaptation, not reproduction of the original batch-2 optimization. Changes are selected without target labels.
profiling.gate_scope: Real logical fixtures, full-batch versus microbatch loss/gradient/Adam parity, checkpoint continuation and transform parity. Record measured differences. Largest-graph resource disposition alone cannot replace numerical checks.

analytical_completion.legacy_hyb: Keep all existing analytical/ outputs immutable, classify its two older Hyb bases and their affine/log-affine variants as legacy diagnostic; do not rename them into r2.
analytical_completion.component_reuse: Join pinned components by unique canonical ID; verify component manifest/source/calibration/compiled-graph hashes and recorded shots against current targets. Ignore old outer_fold/leakage_group columns and old learned predictions; refit on current partitions.
analytical_completion.formula: Use analytical_extension.json hyb and ridge sections unchanged. Finite analytical log cost remains eligible for Ridge even when exponentiation overflows. True zero bucket survival remains unavailable for log-cost, without inferring zero runtime.
analytical_completion.ridge: StandardScaler + Ridge alpha in {0.1,1,10,100}; log1p target; inputs asinh(log_cost) and log1p(shots). Four grouped inner folds select smallest mean source-balanced MAE; exact tie smaller alpha. Fit scaler inside each inner-fit, final refit eligible outer-train. expm1 prediction, negative floor zero, nonfinite failed. Gate-time control uses its independently declared feature/eligibility rules.
analytical_completion.count_meaning: Pre-execution eligibility audit, not fitted coverage/quality or a promised improvement in accuracy.
analytical_completion.keep_other_completed_methods: Retain Qonductor's five folds. Retain QCRE/Qiskit/merged-Scholten projection and calibration only after verifying per-row input identity, units, original reasons, output hashes and successful outer-train calibration membership. Same ID alone is insufficient provenance.
analytical_completion.missing_reason: Preserve original unavailable/failure reason in derived attempts; do not collapse all failures to source_method_unavailable.
analytical_completion.rerun_rule: Rerun only an affected calculation or calibration if provenance/implementation audit fails. Do not rerun raw circuit execution or overwrite completed evidence.

automatic_gates.independence: Validate saved identities, membership, transforms, states and predictions with independently reconstructed expectations; do not merely accept trainer booleans. The routine coordinator may delegate this read-only review to a separate subagent.
before_fit: outer/inner group isolation and every source represented
automatic_gates.early_runtime_QA: After epoch 1 and epoch 10 of every cell, check identity, epoch progression, finite train/validation loss, optimizer state, best-state/transform integrity and telemetry. Check latest progress atomically while training; never load a partially replaced checkpoint.
automatic_gates.first_fold: Six fold-0 neural cells complete at 500 epochs, exact expected held-out IDs with explicit prediction/failure outcomes, matched fitting IDs, proper validation-selected state, three seeds, finite successful predictions and validated polynomial/provenance. PASS unlocks the remaining 24 neural cells automatically.

resources.CPU_parallel_tasks: Hyb projection/folds, input QA, existing simulator-result audit, aggregation scaffolding and documentation.
resources.simulation_timing: No new simulator timing or competing GPU work in this queue.

supervisor.parallel_CPU: Start/resume the specified Hyb job in its pinned CPU environment and allow independent provenance/simulator audits while neural work runs. Bound all auxiliary work to the declared thread/RAM caps. Final aggregation requires their validated terminal outputs.
supervisor.resume: Skip completed cells only after checking their full identity and output hashes. Restore incomplete cells from their identity-matched latest checkpoint.
supervisor.retries: At most two retries per interrupted cell for identified transient process/resource errors; preserve effective batch/profile/optimizer/data. Identity, leakage, nonfinite-loss and formula errors never auto-retry. Persistent errors become visible blocked status.
supervisor.monitoring: Per-cell latest progress updated every epoch; global status contains completed/planned cells, current fold/method/seed, validation state and ETA from measured steady-state epoch/cell times. Profile time is not training ETA.
supervisor.training_timeout: No inherited 90/900-second simulator timeout applies. Flag absent epoch progress beyond max(1800 seconds, five times the median of recent epoch durations) for inspection; do not kill a healthy trainer on wall time alone.
supervisor.resume_after_reboot: Same --resume entrypoint reconstructs state from manifests/checkpoints; no dependence on old PID or conversational memory.

aggregation.log_metric: For finite negative unconstrained predictions, use max(prediction,0) only inside the declared log1p metric, preserve raw prediction for MAE/R2 and count negatives.
aggregation.same_rows: Pairwise and all-method intersections with exact ID-set hash/n; independently recompute each method's scores on that same set. Show full assigned coverage beside every score.
aggregation.bootstrap: 10000 paired group resamples, seed42, using frozen panel group IDs. Record observed delta separately from bootstrap mean and 95% percentile limits. Support source-balanced comparisons without silently dropping an empty source.
aggregation.reconstruction_sensitivity: Reuse same OOF predictions on 4515 rows after excluding candidate_recipe_sensitivity_only. Do not retrain or choose the preferred population by score.
aggregation.input_support: Report graph-only and graph-plus-global seen/unseen input signatures by source with explicit signature definitions; grouping by workflow alone is not proof of unseen graph generalization.
aggregation.reader_policy: One real-QPU table organized by method family with raw/calibrated/sensitivity variants identified. Both target/output clocks, fidelity, input tiers and evidence links are required. Old 8767 results remain separate historical evidence.

simulator_closeout.action: Read-only audit and integrate already selected simulator results from the maintained release selection; no fresh fitting or timing.
required: same-QASM paired metrics within compatible context
all originally considered method families shown with scoped results or explicit unavailable reason
simulator_closeout.missing_artifact: Report a concrete missing source/result/contract as pending; never declare that simulator experiments are all complete from a release-document status alone.

delivery.required: Reproduction commands, exact environment lock, source/helper/input pins, row and feature provenance, assumptions, same-row tables, failure coverage and reconstruction sensitivity. Distinguish table replay from full retraining and hardware-dependent runtime labels.
delivery.minimality: Five planned executable scripts have distinct consumers. Reuse existing runner/helpers. One run-status file, one profile, fold transforms and one manifest per cell; no daily overlays or one-off verification scripts. Checkpoints/progress/caches remain outside the public allowlist.
delivery.public_naming: Export semantic version-free benchmark/ and real_qpu/simulator paths; keep local historical paths in provenance mappings.
delivery.publication: This queue does not authorize commit/push, license/citation decisions, redistribution decisions, raw-artifact deletion or blanket cleanup.
delivery.completion: All 30 neural cells terminal-complete and validated, corrected Hyb/provenance checks complete, same-row aggregates validated, existing simulator scope accounted for, reproduction documentation accurate. A blocked experiment is not silently reported completed.
